svg.title: Fallacies of distributed computing
svg.desc: A checkout service talks to a phone, a menu service, a payment provider and an orders database in another zone. One by one the eight fallacies light up and break: a reply is lost, 10 calls of 15 ms add up to 150 ms, a 5 MB response crawls to the phone, a hacked box reads plain HTTP, the menu server's IP changes, another team's firewall blocks a call, cross zone traffic costs money, and a 64 bit ID gets rounded.
svg.text: On a laptop all eight hold. In production, each one breaks something.
